name: academic-pages
description: Academic Pages Mistakes Jekyll theme npm build scripts

scripts.comment:uglify: Plotly is deliberately NOT bundled here. It was 3.5 MB of a 4.6 MB main.min.js and exactly one page uses it (/markdown/). `build:plotly` copies the dist file to assets/js/vendor/ and _layouts/redesign-default.html loads it only on a page that really contains a plotly fence.
scripts.comment:plotly: assets/js/lib, not assets/js/vendor: _config.yml excludes assets/js/vendor from the build, so a file placed there is never published.
scripts.build:js: npm run uglify && npm run build:plotly
